source_row.rationale: Roflumilast is a phosphodiesterase-4 inhibitor that reduces inflammation associated with severe COPD with chronic bronchitis, used as a maintenance therapy to help reduce exacerbation frequency, rather than as a bronchodilator or rescue medication for acute symptom relief.
source_row.source_detail: PDE-4 Inhibitor Mechanism in Severe COPD
